import os
import json
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

DATA_DIR = 'data'

dynasty_rows = []
redraft_rows = []

for filename in os.listdir(DATA_DIR):
    if filename.endswith('.json'):
        filepath = os.path.join(DATA_DIR, filename)
        with open(filepath, 'r') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
            # Use 'lastUpdated' field for timestamp if available, else fallback to file mtime
            last_updated = data.get('lastUpdated')
            if last_updated:
                try:
                    # Remove 'Z' if present and parse as UTC
                    timestamp = datetime.fromisoformat(last_updated.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
                except Exception:
                    timestamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(filepath))
            else:
                timestamp = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(filepath))
            # Dynasty
            dynasty_row = {'timestamp': timestamp, 'filename': filename}
            if data.get('rankedByDynasty') and 'teams' in data['rankedByDynasty']:
                for team in data['rankedByDynasty']['teams']:
                    team_name = team.get('owner', '')
                    overall_value = team.get('overallValue', None)
                    if team_name:
                        dynasty_row[f'dynasty_team_{team_name}'] = overall_value
            dynasty_rows.append(dynasty_row)
            # Redraft
            redraft_row = {'timestamp': timestamp, 'filename': filename}
            if data.get('rankedByRedraft') and 'teams' in data['rankedByRedraft']:
                for team in data['rankedByRedraft']['teams']:
                    team_name = team.get('owner', '')
                    overall_value = team.get('overallValue', None)
                    if team_name:
                        redraft_row[f'redraft_team_{team_name}'] = overall_value
            redraft_rows.append(redraft_row)

# Create DataFrames
df_dynasty = pd.DataFrame(dynasty_rows).sort_values('timestamp').reset_index(drop=True)
df_redraft = pd.DataFrame(redraft_rows).sort_values('timestamp').reset_index(drop=True)

# Save to CSV (optional)
# df_dynasty.to_csv('dynasty_rankings_by_timestamp.csv', index=False)
# df_redraft.to_csv('redraft_rankings_by_timestamp.csv', index=False)

df_dynasty.tail()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.cm as cm
import numpy as np

# Use the union of all team columns for consistent color mapping
all_team_names = set(
    [col.replace('dynasty_team_', '') for col in df_dynasty.columns if col.startswith('dynasty_team_')] +
    [col.replace('redraft_team_', '') for col in df_redraft.columns if col.startswith('redraft_team_')]
    )
all_team_names = sorted(all_team_names)
color_map = {name: plt.get_cmap('tab20')(i % 20) for i, name in enumerate(all_team_names)}

# Dynasty plot with consistent colors and legend order
dynasty_team_cols = [f'dynasty_team_{name}' for name in all_team_names if f'dynasty_team_{name}' in df_dynasty.columns]
latest_dynasty_date = df_dynasty['timestamp'].max().date()

# Keep the latest complete snapshot per 24-hour period
df_dynasty['date'] = df_dynasty['timestamp'].dt.floor('D')
df_dynasty_resampled = (
    df_dynasty
    .dropna(subset=dynasty_team_cols)
    .sort_values('timestamp')
    .groupby('date', group_keys=False)
    .tail(1)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
 )

# Dynasty plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
for col in dynasty_team_cols:
    name = col.replace('dynasty_team_', '')
    if col in df_dynasty_resampled.columns:
        plt.plot(df_dynasty_resampled['date'], df_dynasty_resampled[col], label=name, color=color_map[name])
plt.title(f'Dynasty Team Overall Value Over Time (Latest: {latest_dynasty_date})')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Overall Value')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Team', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', labels=[col.replace('dynasty_team_', '') for col in dynasty_team_cols])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

redraft_team_cols = [f'redraft_team_{name}' for name in all_team_names if f'redraft_team_{name}' in df_redraft.columns]
latest_redraft_date = df_redraft['timestamp'].max().date()

# Keep the latest complete snapshot per 24-hour period
df_redraft['date'] = df_redraft['timestamp'].dt.floor('D')
df_redraft_resampled = (
    df_redraft
    .dropna(subset=redraft_team_cols)
    .sort_values('timestamp')
    .groupby('date', group_keys=False)
    .tail(1)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
 )

# Redraft plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
for col in redraft_team_cols:
    name = col.replace('redraft_team_', '')
    if col in df_redraft_resampled.columns:
        plt.plot(df_redraft_resampled['date'], df_redraft_resampled[col], label=name, color=color_map[name])
plt.title(f'Redraft Team Overall Value Over Time (Latest: {latest_redraft_date})')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Overall Value')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Team', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', labels=[col.replace('redraft_team_', '') for col in redraft_team_cols])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Compare mean- and median-normalized values using the latest complete snapshot each day.
dynasty_value_cols = [
    f"dynasty_team_{name}"
    for name in all_team_names
    if f"dynasty_team_{name}" in df_dynasty.columns
 ]
df_dynasty_daily = (
    df_dynasty
    .dropna(subset=dynasty_value_cols)
    .sort_values("timestamp")
    .assign(date=lambda data: data["timestamp"].dt.floor("D"))
    .groupby("date", group_keys=False)
    .tail(1)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
 )
daily_team_values = df_dynasty_daily[dynasty_value_cols]
league_mean_by_date = daily_team_values.mean(axis=1)
league_median_by_date = daily_team_values.median(axis=1)
df_dynasty_normalized = pd.DataFrame({"date": df_dynasty_daily["date"]})
df_dynasty_median_normalized = pd.DataFrame({"date": df_dynasty_daily["date"]})

for col in dynasty_value_cols:
    team_name = col.removeprefix("dynasty_team_")
    df_dynasty_normalized[team_name] = daily_team_values[col] / league_mean_by_date * 100
    df_dynasty_median_normalized[team_name] = daily_team_values[col] / league_median_by_date * 100

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6), sharey=True)
for name in all_team_names:
    if name in df_dynasty_normalized.columns:
        axes[0].plot(
            df_dynasty_normalized["date"],
            df_dynasty_normalized[name],
            label=name,
            color=color_map[name],
        )
        axes[1].plot(
            df_dynasty_median_normalized["date"],
            df_dynasty_median_normalized[name],
            label=name,
            color=color_map[name],
        )
axes[0].axhline(100, color="black", linestyle="--", linewidth=1, label="League mean")
axes[1].axhline(100, color="black", linestyle=":", linewidth=1, label="League median")
axes[0].set_title("Normalized to Daily Mean")
axes[1].set_title("Normalized to Daily Median")
for ax in axes:
    ax.set_xlabel("Date")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
axes[0].set_ylabel("Normalized Value (Benchmark = 100)")
handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
median_handles, median_labels = axes[1].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(
    handles + [median_handles[-1]],
    labels + [median_labels[-1]],
    title="Team / Benchmark",
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5),
    loc="center left",
 )
fig.suptitle("Dynasty Team Value Relative to League Average")
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0, 0.86, 0.95))
plt.show()

# Rebase each team's mean-normalized value so its first date equals 100.
df_dynasty_relative_index = df_dynasty_normalized.copy()
normalized_team_names = [name for name in all_team_names if name in df_dynasty_normalized.columns]
for name in normalized_team_names:
    first_relative_value = df_dynasty_normalized[name].iloc[0]
    df_dynasty_relative_index[name] = df_dynasty_normalized[name] / first_relative_value * 100

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
for name in normalized_team_names:
    ax.plot(
        df_dynasty_relative_index["date"],
        df_dynasty_relative_index[name],
        label=name,
        color=color_map[name],
    )
ax.axhline(100, color="black", linestyle="--", linewidth=1, label="Starting level")
ax.set_title("Change in Team Value Relative to League Average (Start = 100)")
ax.set_xlabel("Date")
ax.set_ylabel("Relative Value Index")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45)
ax.legend(title="Team / Baseline", bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left")
ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
fig.tight_layout()

import requests

LEAGUE_ID = "1312337490140475392"  # Paulie's Dynasty League

def sleeper_get(endpoint):
    response = requests.get(f"https://api.sleeper.app/v1/{endpoint}", timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()

league_info = sleeper_get(f"league/{LEAGUE_ID}")
nfl_state = sleeper_get("state/nfl")
season = str(league_info.get("season", nfl_state["season"]))
last_scored_week = int(
    (league_info.get("settings") or {}).get("last_scored_leg")
    or max(int(nfl_state.get("week", 1)) - 1, 0)
 )
if last_scored_week < 1:
    raise ValueError("Sleeper has no completed regular-season weeks to plot yet.")

users = sleeper_get(f"league/{LEAGUE_ID}/users")
rosters = sleeper_get(f"league/{LEAGUE_ID}/rosters")
users_by_id = {user["user_id"]: user for user in users}
team_by_roster_id = {}
for roster in rosters:
    user = users_by_id.get(roster.get("owner_id"), {})
    metadata = user.get("metadata") or {}
    team_by_roster_id[roster["roster_id"]] = (
        metadata.get("team_name")
        or user.get("display_name")
        or user.get("username")
        or f"Roster {roster['roster_id']}"
    )

team_totals = {
    roster_id: {"team": team_name, "total_yards": 0.0, "total_tds": 0.0}
    for roster_id, team_name in team_by_roster_id.items()
}
yard_stat_keys = ("pass_yd", "rush_yd", "rec_yd")
td_stat_keys = ("pass_td", "rush_td", "rec_td")

# Use each week's starters, preserving the lineup that actually scored those stats.
for week in range(1, last_scored_week + 1):
    weekly_stats = sleeper_get(f"stats/nfl/regular/{season}/{week}")
    matchups = sleeper_get(f"league/{LEAGUE_ID}/matchups/{week}")
    for matchup in matchups:
        roster_id = matchup.get("roster_id")
        if roster_id not in team_totals:
            continue
        for player_id in matchup.get("starters", []):
            if not player_id or player_id == "0":
                continue
            player_stats = weekly_stats.get(str(player_id), {})
            team_totals[roster_id]["total_yards"] += sum(
                float(player_stats.get(key) or 0) for key in yard_stat_keys
            )
            team_totals[roster_id]["total_tds"] += sum(
                float(player_stats.get(key) or 0) for key in td_stat_keys
            )

team_production = (
    pd.DataFrame(team_totals.values())
    .sort_values("team")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
    .round({"total_yards": 1, "total_tds": 1})
 )
display(team_production)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 7))
team_colors = {
    team: plt.get_cmap("tab20")(index % 20)
    for index, team in enumerate(team_production["team"])
}
ax.scatter(
    team_production["total_yards"],
    team_production["total_tds"],
    c=[team_colors[team] for team in team_production["team"]],
    s=90,
    alpha=0.85,
    edgecolors="black",
    linewidths=0.5,
 )

# Add a least-squares linear regression line across the team totals.
if len(team_production) >= 2:
    slope, intercept = np.polyfit(
        team_production["total_yards"],
        team_production["total_tds"],
        1,
    )
    regression_x = np.linspace(
        team_production["total_yards"].min(),
        team_production["total_yards"].max(),
        100,
    )
    ax.plot(
        regression_x,
        slope * regression_x + intercept,
        color="black",
        linestyle="--",
        linewidth=2,
        label="Linear regression",
    )
    ax.legend()

for _, row in team_production.iterrows():
    ax.annotate(
        row["team"],
        (row["total_yards"], row["total_tds"]),
        xytext=(5, 5),
        textcoords="offset points",
        fontsize=8,
    )
ax.set_title(f"Team Yards vs. Touchdowns, {season} Regular Season (Weeks 1-{last_scored_week})")
ax.set_xlabel("Starter Passing + Rushing + Receiving Yards")
ax.set_ylabel("Starter Passing + Rushing + Receiving Touchdowns")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Choose the season start date
season_start = pd.Timestamp("2026-07-17", tz="UTC")

# Find the first snapshot on or after the season start
mask = df_dynasty["timestamp"] >= season_start
if not mask.any():
    raise ValueError("No snapshots found on or after July 17, 2026.")

start_idx = df_dynasty.index[mask][0]

# Calculate the difference between the dynasty value at the season start and the current value
value_diff_cols = [name for name in all_team_names if f'dynasty_team_{name}' in df_dynasty.columns]
df_diff = pd.DataFrame({'timestamp': df_dynasty['timestamp']})

for name in value_diff_cols:
    dynasty_col = f'dynasty_team_{name}'
    initial_value = df_dynasty.loc[start_idx, dynasty_col]
    df_diff[name] = df_dynasty[dynasty_col] - initial_value

# Only include data from the current season
df_diff = df_diff[df_diff["timestamp"] >= season_start].copy()

# Resample data to the latest value per 24-hour period
df_diff['date'] = df_diff['timestamp'].dt.floor('D')
df_resampled = (
    df_diff
    .sort_values('timestamp')
    .groupby('date')
    .last()
    .reset_index()
)

# Plot the difference over time
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
for name in value_diff_cols:
    if name in df_resampled.columns:
        plt.plot(df_resampled['date'], df_resampled[name], label=name, color=color_map[name])

plt.title('Difference in Dynasty Value from Start of Season')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Value Difference (Current - Initial)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Team', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', labels=value_diff_cols)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd

DATA_DIR = Path("data")

records = []

for file in sorted(DATA_DIR.glob("fantasycalc_*.json")):

    timestamp = pd.to_datetime(
        file.stem.replace("fantasycalc_", ""),
        format="%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ",
        utc=True
    )

    with open(file, "r") as f:
        league = json.load(f)

    league_name = league["name"]

    for team in league["teams"]:

        owner = team["owner"]
        team_name = team["name"]

        for roster_player in team["players"]:

            player = roster_player["player"]

            # Ignore rookie picks
            if player["position"] == "PICK":
                continue

            records.append({
                "timestamp": timestamp,

                "owner": owner,
                "team_name": team_name,

                "player_id": player["id"],
                "player_name": player["name"],
                "position": player["position"],

                "value": roster_player["value"],
                "overall_rank": roster_player["overallRank"],
                "position_rank": roster_player["positionRank"],

                "starter": roster_player.get("starter", False),

                "nfl_team": player.get("maybeTeam"),
                "age": player.get("maybeAge"),
                "league_name": league_name,
            })

player_history = (
    pd.DataFrame(records)
      .sort_values(["player_id", "timestamp"])
      .reset_index(drop=True)
)

player_history["snapshot"] = (
    player_history["timestamp"]
    .rank(method="dense")
    .astype(int)
)

player_history["week"] = (
    player_history["timestamp"]
    .dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
)

player_history

# =============================================================================
# Build Player Tenures
#
# A new tenure ONLY begins when a player changes owners in consecutive snapshots.
# Gaps in a player's history (waivers, missing snapshots, etc.) do NOT create
# new tenures.
# =============================================================================

player_history = (
    player_history
    .sort_values(["player_id", "timestamp"])
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Previous observation for each player
player_history["prev_owner"] = (
    player_history.groupby("player_id")["owner"].shift()
)

player_history["prev_snapshot"] = (
    player_history.groupby("player_id")["snapshot"].shift()
)

# Was the previous observation the immediately previous snapshot?
player_history["consecutive_prev"] = (
    player_history["snapshot"] - player_history["prev_snapshot"] == 1
)

# Start a new tenure only if:
#   - first appearance of player
#   - OR owner changed in consecutive snapshots
player_history["new_tenure"] = (
    player_history["prev_owner"].isna()
    |
    (
        player_history["consecutive_prev"]
        &
        (player_history["owner"] != player_history["prev_owner"])
    )
)

player_history["tenure_id"] = (
    player_history
    .groupby("player_id")["new_tenure"]
    .cumsum()
)

player_tenures = (
    player_history
    .groupby(["player_id", "tenure_id"], as_index=False)
    .agg(
        player_name=("player_name", "first"),
        position=("position", "first"),

        owner=("owner", "first"),
        team_name=("team_name", "first"),

        tenure_start=("timestamp", "first"),
        tenure_end=("timestamp", "last"),

        start_snapshot=("snapshot", "first"),
        end_snapshot=("snapshot", "last"),

        start_value=("value", "first"),
        end_value=("value", "last"),

        start_rank=("overall_rank", "first"),
        end_rank=("overall_rank", "last"),

        snapshots=("timestamp", "size")
    )
)

player_tenures["value_change"] = (
    player_tenures["end_value"]
    - player_tenures["start_value"]
)

player_tenures["pct_change"] = (
    100
    * player_tenures["value_change"]
    / player_tenures["start_value"]
).round(1)

player_tenures["days"] = (
    player_tenures["tenure_end"]
    - player_tenures["tenure_start"]
).dt.days

player_tenures = (
    player_tenures
    .sort_values(["tenure_start", "player_name"])
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Biggest gainers
display(player_tenures.nlargest(10, "value_change"))

# Biggest losers
display(player_tenures.nsmallest(10, "value_change"))

# =============================================================================
# Trade Alpha
# =============================================================================

player_tenures = (
    player_tenures
    .sort_values(["player_id", "tenure_start"])
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Information about the next tenure
player_tenures["next_owner"] = (
    player_tenures.groupby("player_id")["owner"].shift(-1)
)

player_tenures["next_start_snapshot"] = (
    player_tenures.groupby("player_id")["start_snapshot"].shift(-1)
)

player_tenures["next_start_value"] = (
    player_tenures.groupby("player_id")["start_value"].shift(-1)
)

player_tenures["next_end_value"] = (
    player_tenures.groupby("player_id")["end_value"].shift(-1)
)

player_tenures["next_tenure_end"] = (
    player_tenures.groupby("player_id")["tenure_end"].shift(-1)
)

# Valid trade if the next tenure starts immediately after this one ends
player_tenures["is_direct_trade"] = (
    player_tenures["next_owner"].notna()
    &
    (
        player_tenures["next_start_snapshot"]
        ==
        player_tenures["end_snapshot"] + 1
    )
)

completed_trades = (
    player_tenures[player_tenures["is_direct_trade"]]
    .copy()
)

# Positive = good sell
# Negative = sold too early
completed_trades["trade_alpha"] = (
    completed_trades["end_value"]
    - completed_trades["next_end_value"]
)

completed_trades["acquired_alpha"] = (
    -completed_trades["trade_alpha"]
)

trade_alpha_summary = (
    completed_trades
    .groupby("owner")
    .agg(
        trades=("player_id", "count"),
        total_alpha=("trade_alpha", "sum"),
        average_alpha=("trade_alpha", "mean"),
        median_alpha=("trade_alpha", "median"),
    )
    .sort_values("total_alpha", ascending=False)
)

print("=== Trade Alpha Leaderboard ===")
display(trade_alpha_summary)

print("\n=== Best Sells ===")
display(
    completed_trades.nlargest(
        10,
        "trade_alpha"
    )[
        [
            "player_name",
            "owner",
            "next_owner",
            "tenure_end",
            "end_value",
            "next_end_value",
            "trade_alpha",
        ]
    ]
)

print("\n=== Sold Too Early ===")
display(
    completed_trades.nsmallest(
        10,
        "trade_alpha"
    )[
        [
            "player_name",
            "owner",
            "next_owner",
            "tenure_end",
            "end_value",
            "next_end_value",
            "trade_alpha",
        ]
    ]
)

from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA_DIR = Path("data")
snapshot_by_date = {}

for file in sorted(DATA_DIR.glob("fantasycalc_*.json")):
    timestamp = pd.to_datetime(
        file.stem.removeprefix("fantasycalc_"),
        format="%Y-%m-%dT%H-%M-%SZ",
        utc=True,
    )
    date = timestamp.floor("D")
    with file.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as source:
        league = json.load(source)

    teams = {}
    for team in (league.get("rankedByDynasty") or {}).get("teams", []):
        owner = team.get("owner")
        if not owner:
            continue
        asset_values = {}
        asset_occurrences = {}
        for roster_asset in team.get("players", []):
            player = roster_asset.get("player") or {}
            base_asset_id = player.get("id")
            if base_asset_id is not None:
                base_asset_id = str(base_asset_id)
                occurrence = asset_occurrences.get(base_asset_id, 0)
                asset_occurrences[base_asset_id] = occurrence + 1
                asset_id = f"{base_asset_id}#{occurrence}"
                asset_values[asset_id] = float(roster_asset.get("value") or 0)
        teams[owner] = {
            "assets": asset_values,
            "reported_value": float(team.get("overallValue") or 0),
        }

    # Sorted filenames are timestamped, so this retains the latest snapshot for each day.
    snapshot_by_date[date] = {"timestamp": timestamp, "teams": teams}

daily_snapshots = [snapshot_by_date[date] for date in sorted(snapshot_by_date)]
attribution_rows = []
for previous, current in zip(daily_snapshots, daily_snapshots[1:]):
    for owner in sorted(set(previous["teams"]) | set(current["teams"])):
        previous_team = previous["teams"].get(owner, {"assets": {}, "reported_value": 0})
        current_team = current["teams"].get(owner, {"assets": {}, "reported_value": 0})
        previous_assets = previous_team["assets"]
        current_assets = current_team["assets"]
        retained_assets = previous_assets.keys() & current_assets.keys()
        added_assets = current_assets.keys() - previous_assets.keys()
        departed_assets = previous_assets.keys() - current_assets.keys()
        retained_asset_repricing = sum(
            current_assets[asset_id] - previous_assets[asset_id]
            for asset_id in retained_assets
        )
        additions_value = sum(current_assets[asset_id] for asset_id in added_assets)
        departures_value = -sum(
            previous_assets[asset_id] for asset_id in departed_assets
        )
        reported_value_change = (
            current_team["reported_value"] - previous_team["reported_value"]
        )
        net_roster_change = additions_value + departures_value
        asset_value_change = retained_asset_repricing + net_roster_change
        attribution_rows.append({
            "date": current["timestamp"],
            "team": owner,
            "retained_asset_repricing": retained_asset_repricing,
            "additions_value": additions_value,
            "departures_value": departures_value,
            "net_roster_change": net_roster_change,
            "asset_value_change": asset_value_change,
            "reported_value_change": reported_value_change,
        })

df_value_attribution = pd.DataFrame(attribution_rows)
assert np.allclose(
    df_value_attribution["asset_value_change"],
    df_value_attribution["reported_value_change"],
    atol=1e-6,
), "Asset-level attribution does not reconcile to reported team values."
df_value_attribution = df_value_attribution.sort_values(["team", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
for column in ("retained_asset_repricing", "net_roster_change", "reported_value_change"):
    df_value_attribution[f"cumulative_{column}"] = (
        df_value_attribution.groupby("team")[column].cumsum()
    )

attribution_summary = (
    df_value_attribution
    .groupby("team")
    .agg(
        repricing=("retained_asset_repricing", "sum"),
        additions=("additions_value", "sum"),
        departures=("departures_value", "sum"),
        net_roster_change=("net_roster_change", "sum"),
        total_value_change=("reported_value_change", "sum"),
    )
    .sort_values("total_value_change", ascending=False)
    .round(1)
 )
display(attribution_summary)

team_names = sorted(df_value_attribution["team"].unique())
column_count = 3
row_count = math.ceil(len(team_names) / column_count)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(
    row_count,
    column_count,
    figsize=(18, 4 * row_count),
    sharex=True,
    squeeze=False,
 )
for ax, team_name in zip(axes.flat, team_names):
    team_data = df_value_attribution[df_value_attribution["team"] == team_name]
    ax.plot(
        team_data["date"],
        team_data["cumulative_retained_asset_repricing"],
        label="Asset repricing",
        color="tab:blue",
    )
    ax.plot(
        team_data["date"],
        team_data["cumulative_net_roster_change"],
        label="Net roster changes",
        color="tab:orange",
    )
    ax.plot(
        team_data["date"],
        team_data["cumulative_reported_value_change"],
        label="Total value change",
        color="black",
        linestyle="--",
    )
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_title(team_name)
    ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
for ax in axes.flat[len(team_names):]:
    ax.set_visible(False)
fig.supylabel("Cumulative Dynasty value change")
fig.supxlabel("Date")
handles, labels = axes.flat[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels, loc="lower center", ncol=3, bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.01))
fig.suptitle("Team Value Change: Asset Repricing vs. Roster Moves")
fig.tight_layout(rect=(0, 0.04, 1, 0.96))
plt.show()
